sources.entry: Scrypted | Home video integration platform and NVR

summary.one_liner: Scrypted is a home video integration platform and NVR with smart detections that streams camera video to HomeKit, Google Home, and Alexa.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Scrypted as a high performance home video integration platform and NVR with smart detections. It says it provides instant, low latency streaming to HomeKit, Google Home, and Alexa, and that it supports most cameras. Installation and camera onboarding are covered in external docs, not in the README. The README also covers plugin development: it describes cloning the repo, running ./npm-install.sh, and debugging plugins such as HomeKit in VS Code, with changes deployed to the running server without restarting it. A Plugin SDK is referenced for writing custom plugins. The server itself is described only as hosting and RPC for plugins.
use_cases: stream home security cameras to HomeKit
view camera feeds in Google Home or Alexa
network video recorder with smart detections
integrate cameras into a home automation setup
how_to_run: npm run build && npm run scrypted-deploy 127.0.0.1
notable: Low latency streaming of camera video to HomeKit, Google Home, and Alexa
Plugin-based architecture where the server handles hosting and RPC for plugins
Plugins can be edited and redeployed to the running server without restarting it
Plugin SDK documentation for writing custom plugins
caveats: Installation and camera onboarding are in external docs, not the README
README does not list supported camera models or hardware requirements
Server debugging is described as mostly unnecessary; plugin development is the main path
